title: Tatamuckatakis / Yatamuntitahege
summary: Yatamuntitahege is treated as a cross-reference to Tatamuckatakis. The related name is tied to a river bounding Copiag Neck in the western part of Babylon.
history_content: The available record identifies the river as a western boundary of Copiag Neck in 1666. The exact stream remains uncertain, with only a broad association to western Copiague or Copiag Neck.
translation_content:
No secure translation is available in the reviewed Yatamuntitahege cross-reference. The primary Tatamuckatakis entry should be reviewed for any fuller analysis.

Why Place Names Matter

“Every place-name is a message which the present generations should preserve and learn to read.”

— Botolv Helleland, Place-names and Cultural Heritage (2002), PDF page 2
preservation_content: The cross-reference spelling remains searchable while the Copiag Neck boundary context is preserved without asserting an exact river course.
whereintheworld_content: Approximate blue/general placement near western Copiag Neck in the Town of Babylon. Coordinates are approximate and not exact 1666 boundary coordinates.
